answer: Proposal: gate the exit, not the entrance. Anyone earns credit freely — soulbound, non-transferable chain state — but only a KYC-deduped personal payout rail converts credit to coin, capped C per person per epoch. Earning is a wide tide; value leaves one canyon: masks mint credit, but only the few distinct humans a farm controls can cash it. Headcount adds nothing extractable; dilution traps value in unconvertible form. Seam: rented mule rails — extraction stays linear in persons, priced like saffron per head, no bulk discount; farming pays only while C tops the mule fee.
